resolution: Surgically recovered Heroin_Bob_head's 15-part outliner from the flattened save. The bad paint-before-save wrote doc.blob with rangeCount=0 and collapsed parts.json to one 'Cube 1' row, but the per-triangle authored face groups (690 ids) survived intact. Recomputed part boundaries offline using the exact inferMeshDocPartRanges algorithm (union by group id + shared exact-position edges) — got exactly 15 contiguous connectivity runs whose geometry matches the original ranks (skull cube, ear cylinders at ±x, eye icospheres, mouth cube, 6 mohawk cones, ground plane). Patched the 15-range table back into doc.blob (header rangeCount + appended pairs, verified against the RJMD v2 decoder's need formula) and rebuilt parts.json with the original 15 names captured earlier this session, default clay #c9b48f colors. Flattened originals backed up in session scratchpad heroin_bob_recovery/. No code changed; model files only (untracked).
